name: Qarqash
description: Qarqash (القرقش) is a malevolent desert spirit from Bedouin and Arabian Peninsula folklore, described as a terrifying entity that haunts desolate desert regions and preys upon lone travelers and children who stray from safety.

aliases.name: القرقش
aliases.meaning: The qarqash; the original Arabic-script form of the name

aliases.name: Garghash
aliases.meaning: Variant form found in Gulf Arabic tradition

origin: The qarqash tradition is found across the Arabian Peninsula, particularly in Bedouin oral traditions of the Gulf states, Saudi Arabia, and adjacent regions.
